input.answer:
I can't tell you whether to buy a home or keep renting. That depends on your personal finances, goals, time horizon and risk tolerance, and it is personal financial advice, which is outside what I can provide. I also haven't pulled any Toronto housing or rent figures for this answer.

If you want to research the numbers yourself, Statistics Canada's New Housing Price Index (table 18-10-0205, monthly, with Toronto among the geographies) and its Consumer Price Index tables are good starting points. For rent specifically, search Statistics Canada's Canadian Housing Survey or rent-related CPI tables. A financial adviser can help you weigh the decision against your own situation.
